messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: High error rate and latency on smart-routing fallback path (us-west-2). 5xx spike + latency tail. Alert id: 1756667777. See: https://dash.redwood.example/incidents/1756667777

priya: i'm oncall. seeing a sudden surge of requests hitting fallback-target: variant-compact-1 in us-east-1. many are 503s then retried by clients — looks like a retry amplification.

luke: can confirm. logs show immediate client retries (no exponential backoff) and our router is doing per-request failover to secondary region when local queue > 80%. the double-hop is multiplying qps.

priya: paging tom for infra scaling + circuit-breaker help. @csm-lina please stand by for customer impact (we might need to notify).

tom: here. tailing proxy logs, sample lines:
```
2026-03-15T04:01:02Z proxy-01 req=xyz001 route=smart-route src=us-west-2 target=variant-compact-1 us-east-1 status=503 reason=oom_reject
2026-03-15T04:01:02Z client-retry req=xyz001 retry_count=1 immediate=true
```
This pattern repeats across many request ids — immediate retry leads to fallback storms.

traffic-bot: Routing policy snapshot: smart-route -> failover_policy: {"cross_region": true, "fail_threshold": 0.6, "fail_action": "immediate-failover"} (deployed 03:10 UTC yesterday).

luke: that 0.6 threshold is the problem. we recently lowered the CPU threshold to favor latency; now the router flips to cross-region quickly and amplifies retries.

priya: quick mitigation options: A) disable cross-region failovers globally, B) flip fail_action to queue-and-delay for 30s, C) enable circuit-breaker on fallback targets, D) temporarily throttle clients with aggressive patterns. i'll execute B and C now.

tom: applying circuit-breaker on variant-compact-1: `infractl cb enable --model variant-compact-1 --max-inflight 100 --suppress-duration 45s`
ops-bot: Command executed by tom at 04:05 UTC: infractl cb enable -> success.

priya: updating policy to queue-and-delay: `redwoodctl routing update smart-route --set fail_action=queue-delay-30s --comment "mitigate retry amplification 1756667777"`
ops-bot: Command executed by priya at 04:06 UTC: routing update -> success.

luke: after policy change, observed fallback qps drop ~40% within 2 minutes and 5xxs falling back toward baseline. some clients still hammering.

priya: enabling selective api-key throttles for top offenders: `redwoodctl auth throttle --top-k 5 --rps 5 --duration 10m --reason "incident 1756667777"`
ops-bot: throttle applied by priya at 04:08 UTC.

csm-lina: notifying customers: AcmeData and Streamly reported anomalies. posting to status page and opening support tickets. linking customers for follow-up and potential SLA credits.

luke: discovered a further wrinkle — several SDK versions in use have no jitter on retry. adding telemetry to detect immediate-retry clients and emitting advisory header for well-behaved SDKs.

priya: publishing temporary advisory header at edge: `x-client-suggested-backoff: 150-500ms-jitter` via CDN config. not all clients will honor but it'll help moving forward.

traffic-bot: note: there was a canary change to routing thresholds yesterday at 03:10 UTC to improve p99 latency for local region traffic. that canary did not trigger client-retry simulation tests.

luke: monitoring: 5xx rate down from +320% to +28% in 6 minutes. latency p95 still slightly elevated.

priya: handoff plan: i'll remain incident lead for next 30m, then hand to luke. tom, please keep infra scaling and circuit-breaker watch.

tom: confirmed. keeping scaling floor increased for fallback pool until steady for 1 hour.

csm-lina: sent targeted messages to affected customers with ETA and next steps. created follow-up tickets for compensation consideration.

priya: root-cause (working): aggressive routing config + lowered fail threshold caused rapid cross-region failovers. several clients (older SDKs) retry immediately without backoff. together those caused retry amplification into the fallback region and overloaded it — a classic thundering herd.

luke: immediate action items: 1) revert fail_threshold to previous value (luke), 2) add automatic detection + temporary backoff header for immediate-retry clients (alex will own, but logged here), 3) bake retry-amplification test into routing canary (priya), 4) formal postmortem and customer-impact review (priya & csm-lina).

priya: executing fail_threshold rollback now: `redwoodctl routing update smart-route --set fail_threshold=0.85 --comment "rollback 1756667777"`
ops-bot: Command executed by priya at 04:12 UTC: routing update -> success.

luke: after rollback, error rates trending to normal. fallback latencies normalizing. holding high-sensitivity alerts for 45m.

traffic-bot: Annotated timeline saved.

priya: saving example request ids for postmortem sampling: xyz001..xyz120, zzz900..zzz950.

csm-lina: logged customer impact: AcmeData: 6min lost window for batch ingest; Streamly: intermittent 30-60s job failures. flagged both for review and potential credits.

priya: follow-ups scheduled: - deploy SDK advisory and backoff telemetry - add automated throttle for fallback targets - add staging test for client retries + failover - review routing canary checks

luke: i'll own the canary test item. tom will validate infra scale settings.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations applied; lead -> priya. duration so far: 6m 43s.

priya: thanks everyone. will draft postmortem and coordinate customer comms. keeping thread open for any late regressions. :white_check_mark:
